name: TransmissionRemote
description: TransmissionRemote — a HarmonyOS client for the Transmission BitTorrent daemon, plus the ArkTS RPC SDK behind it. Host-side Node.js tooling lives in scripts/.

scripts.build:har: node scripts/run-hvigor.mjs assembleHar --mode module -p module=transmission_sdk@default -p product=default
scripts.build:app: node scripts/run-hvigor.mjs assembleApp --mode project -p product=default -p buildMode=release
